study_status: Retrospective public-data evaluation, selected panel, known assay contexts; outcome-unseen analysis specification, not prospective raw-count preprocessing or independent experimental validation.
goal: Test context information beyond shared DNA and context means, and sequence-by-context slopes beyond additive offsets on held-out sequence families; retain negative results.

source.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 as declared by the source Zenodo record; retain source attribution and license snapshot, fail closed if score-data reuse scope is contradicted.
source.source_version_caveat: Zenodo10558183 is a preprint-associated release: Table S7 joint lib design.xlsx must not silently be called final-paper Supplementary Table10. Establish identity/schema from actual source headers and authoritative methods. Do not assert all final-paper sequences or endpoints are present.
source.selection_caveat: Joint panel deliberately selected using prior activity bins, with variable-promoter selection; not a random or unselected genomic sample. Fixed source panel, not a score-selected favorable subset.

archive.integrity: A partial member acquisition cannot verify whole-archive MD5. Validate ZIP local/central metadata, compressed bounds, decompression, exact uncompressed size and CRC32; retain range/HTTP receipts and SHA256 of each member.

source.member_role: Candidate measured-label provenance only, not assumed ground truth. Source fold names never define our folds. Reject CNN predictions/augmentations as empirical labels.
source.acquisition_scope: Only the two listed workbooks and 30 listed source archive members under this version. Header/schema inspection and verification permitted after freezing. If they lack required measured endpoint or sequence/coordinates, record blocked acquisition and stop; no substitute data, endpoint or score source without separately versioned protocol.
source.acquisition_order: Inspect both bounded workbooks first: Table S7 then Table S9. Retrieve listed archive members only if necessary to establish or cross-check measured labels under the semantic endpoint contract; prediction-only files do not justify continued label acquisition.

semantic_endpoint_contract.required_measurement: Observed lentiMPRA reporter activity: arithmetic mean of three published per-replicate median-normalized log2(RNA/DNA) activity measurements in each context, or a documented published aggregate exactly equal to that mean.
semantic_endpoint_contract.units: log2 reporter RNA/DNA activity; MSE squared log2 units; MAE log2 units
forbidden_labels: activity bins used for design selection
surrogate scores inferred from source column names alone
semantic_endpoint_contract.schema_binding: After header-only inspection, create a source-hashed schema-binding artifact naming every measured replicate/aggregate, assayed-DNA, stableID, parent and coordinate field plus authoritative semantic evidence. Headers alone cannot prove empirical-label identity. No fitting or outcome-pattern inspection unless all contract requirements pass. Binding may map columns and documented NA tokens but cannot change endpoint, transform, cohort source, models or loss.
semantic_endpoint_contract.source_priority: Inspect S7 then S9; use unambiguously documented measured endpoint in either workbook. The listed archive members may supply or cross-check measured values only if explicitly observed, never predicted. If multiple legitimate measured copies disagree beyond documented source precision, fail rather than selecting a favorable copy.
semantic_endpoint_contract.source_normalization: Accept explicitly documented published median normalization as part of the source endpoint; it may use the entire source experiment. No claim to prospective/training-only raw-count normalization. No new all-panel z-scoring, activity centering or response scaling.
semantic_endpoint_contract.replicates: Replicates, barcodes, molecules, augmentations and repeated file copies are not independent elements. Do not average source predictions. Require all three finite measured replicates or a documented exact three-replicate aggregate; no invented pseudocounts or reconstruction from predictions.

cohort.primary: All source joint-library element identities with an unambiguous same assayed insert in all three contexts, finite required observed activity, unambiguous same-assembly coordinates and valid sequence, subject only to this fixed semantic/metadata eligibility.
cohort.coordinates: Verified single reference assembly and chromosome naming, zero-based half-open start/end, start>=0,end>start. Establish source coordinate convention from evidence; do not guess or silently liftover.
cohort.reference_mapping: Record strand, assayed sequence, reference mapping and any documented synthetic/adapter differences. Interval must refer unambiguously to the assayed element; if this cannot be shown, block the primary analysis.
cohort.duplicates: Preserve distinct source element IDs including exact/RC DNA duplicates, group them together and report duplicate multiplicities. Reject duplicate element/context observations from repeated files unless exact duplicate provenance is recorded and only one copy contributes. Different source IDs are not evidence of independent experiments.
cohort.exclusions: No activity magnitude/rank, pvalue, activity-bin, observed predictability or replicate-agreement threshold. Missing/nonfinite endpoint, incomplete context, invalid DNA or ambiguous sequence/coordinate semantics excluded with reason; all excluded source records retained in an audit. Do not silently add new raw count filters.
cohort.missingness_report: Retain incomplete records separately with counts and reasons by context and source; no outcome imputation and no primary complete-case claim about missing elements.
cohort.external_scope: No unseen-context or across-study transfer claim. All three contexts belong to one source study; study selection and prior activity ascertainment constrain generalization.

union_rules: any shared touched1000000bp genomic bin anchored0
equal-length global ungapped identity>=90percent in either orientation
grouping.bins: For[start,end), floor(start/1000000)..floor((end-1)/1000000), inclusive; a crossing interval unions both bins.
grouping.hamming: For length L, k=floor(L/10). Join iff min(Hamming(a,b),Hamming(a,reverse_complement(b)))<=k. Unequal-length, indel and partial homology not guaranteed.
grouping.candidate_generation: Exact exhaustive pigeonhole index: k+1 nonempty segments with boundaries floor(j*L/(k+1)), j=0..k+1; index both orientations by(length,segment_index,exact_substring), deduplicate unordered source-element pairs, exact fullHamming verification. Equivalent exact implementation permitted with identical components.
grouping.budget_policy: Abort before fitting if more than100000000 distinct unordered candidate pairs or resource failure; never cap/skip buckets, discard sequences, approximate completeness or continue partial results. Retain abort receipt.
grouping.connected_components: Transitive union of all rules; never split a component for fold balance.
grouping.component_id: SHA256 UTF8 newline-joined lexicographically sorted stable source element IDs; reject IDs containing newline. Store member list and hash.

feasibility.failure: Abort primary study; do not weaken grouping after outcomes.

outer_folds.algorithm: Sort components by decreasing element count then ascending component_id; lexicographic sortedID list is final collision tiebreak. Greedily assign to fold with smallest current element count; foldindex0..4 breaks ties. All three contexts of each element stay together.
outer_folds.guard: Exclude an entire training component if any of its intervals has same-chromosome distance<=10000bp to any test interval. Distance0 for overlap or adjacency, otherwise half-open gap. Preserve every test element and its three contexts.

feasibility.failure: Abort if any guarded fold violates fraction or context coverage, or has no test elements; do not report a successful primary fit.

outer_folds.ledger: Persist preoutcome element/group/fold metadata, candidate count, all guard exclusions, sizes and minimum distances; source testfold labels are not our folds.

features.definition: Count overlapping canonical 3mers, canonical=min(trimer,reverse_complement(trimer)); divide integer counts once by L-2. GC=count(G orC)/L. Counts, length and DNA hashes reported but length not predictor.
features.orientation: Reverse-complement invariant insert composition; no vector/adaptor flanks or implicit extra sequence.
features.scaling: One training-only transform from unique training element records, shared all contexts. Population SD ddof0; SD<=1e-12 ->scale1. No test sequence or response enters scaling.

fit.shared_objective: n sequence-mean targets: sum_s(mean_c(y_sc)-m-z_s*beta)^2 +10*||beta||^2. Equivalent pooled n*C row objective uses C*10 penalty.
fit.solve: (ZtransposeZ+10I)beta=Ztranspose centered_target; fixed ridge; no tuning or feature selection.

models.prediction: m+dot(z,beta); beta fitted once to per-element context-mean target
m_c+dot(z,beta), direct contextmean-plus-dot arithmetic, exact same stored slope object asshared_dna
m_c+dot(z,beta_c), fixed separate ridge response per observed context, common training design/scaler/factorization

invariants: mean_c(beta_c)=shared beta within fixed numerical tolerance
mean_c(independent predictions)=mean_c(additive predictions) within fixed tolerance
test-only outcome perturbation leaves all fitted quantities unchanged

evaluation.primary_loss: MSE: mean across3contexts per eligible assayed element, then mean across elements; equal-element weighting, not equal-component weighting.
evaluation.secondary_loss: MAE with the same weighting; percontext MSE/MAE; equal-component MSE as fixed sensitivity only.
evaluation.improvement_sign: baselineMSE-candidateMSE; positive favors candidate; retain all3comparisons and5models.
evaluation.pair_context_diagnostic: All3contextpairs: observed y_c-y_d and predicted differences for additive andindependent models; report equal-element MSE/MAE for everypair, no bestpair selection.
evaluation.rank_metrics: No exact-rank endpoint or acceptance criterion. No rankepsilon, selected precision grid or rank-based success claim.
evaluation.claims: Activity prediction in fixed known contexts only. Offsets alone are not context-dependent DNA effects. Interaction improvement is model-relative predictive evidence, not a causal mechanism or discovery of context dependence, which prior source work already studies.

resampling.method: Conditional paired connected-component bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold losses; no refitting.
resampling.prng: SplitMix64 unsigned64 wrapping; state+=0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z=(z xor(z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z=(z xor(z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB; output=z xor(z>>31). index=output modulo component_count.
resampling.draws: For each replicate draw K component IDs independently with replacement, K=number of components. Same index table for all3contrasts and reported5model loss summaries. Keep full member/context clusters.
resampling.statistic: Pool per-element context-mean paired-loss sums across sampled components with multiplicity; divide by sampled element count. Uniform component sampling does not mean averaging component means. Primary remains equal-element.
resampling.interval: Type7 empirical quantiles0.025and0.975, 95percent conditional percentile ranges; report all3without significance declaration or selectedinterval.
resampling.inference_limitations: Fixed selected panel and fitted predictions; ignores refitting uncertainty, finite-source selection, residual intercomponent correlations and study-to-study variation. Not calibrated biologicalpvalues or genome-population confidence guarantees.
resampling.null_pvalues: none; no hypothesis-significance or novelty claim from percentile ranges.

independent_verification.failures: Retain failed attempts; diagnose semantic bugs explicitly; do not silently widen tolerances or claim complete reproduction if any requiredcheckfails.

required_outputs: semantic endpoint acceptance or blocked-acquisition report
amendments: This frozen protocol is immutable after announced SHA256. Header/schema binding may instantiate its fixed semantic fields but cannot change them. Any new file/endpoint/model/group threshold after failure needs a new separatelyversioned protocol and explicit outcome-exposure disclosure.
